Dfn interruptConversationSelf first requests follower owner interruption; only follower timeout/version-mismatch/no-client-found marks resume and falls back local. System/user/descendant modes have distinct goal pause order and user 500ms critical timeout; goal pause failure can attach interruptedTurnId after interruption.

Dfn interruptConversation finally conditionally interrupts descendants unless descendant-cleanup/follower; user-stop uses background cleanup, other modes await it. Completion of the parent UI promise is not a claim that all descendants or notification reducers have completed.
